mission_phase: Generation 39 - Furniture search relevance: Industry West (legacy WooCommerce) vs Seven Bonde (new Shopify) old-vs-new evaluation
phase_goal: Evaluate on-site search relevance for the Furniture sector focused on Industry West, comparing the legacy industrywest.com WooCommerce search against the new sevenbonde.com Shopify storefront that Industry West is replatforming to. One shared 50-query furniture pack (synonym-equivalence, attribute material+type, job-function/intent, head terms), captured per store, graded 0-3 by the local Cortex judge (llama3.2:3b, temp 0) as NDCG, and decomposed into coverage (zero-result rate) and precision (grade quality). Every finding traces to a replayable query (Store API URL / in-session site search) + Cortex trace. artifact_profile: search_ir_evaluation.
reason_generation_started: Operator asked to focus on Furniture / Industry West, build a repeatable dataset->capture->Cortex->NDCG flow, find genuine good/bad behaviors, and compare. Mid-flow the operator observed industrywest.com 'Shop All' redirecting to sevenbonde.com; investigation confirmed a live replatform (301 redirect; Seven Bonde re-hosts the IW catalog). Operator directed: evaluate Seven Bonde too, compare old vs new, and (later) restore MDE evidence discipline before any report.
standing_directive: Evidence-only, no fabricated grades/counts. Industry West captured via its public WooCommerce Store API (UA Northvalley-Ecommerce-Inspection/0.1, ~300-650ms pacing, robots-respecting). Seven Bonde captured via the site's OWN in-session Shopify Storefront search (the browser's real search request/token; NO bot-protection bypass) after its default /search and .json endpoints 404'd to non-browser fetches - those were NOT spoofed around. Keep work local; commit/push only when the operator asks. Report deferred until results validated. Every claim must trace to preserved, replayable evidence.

functional: Both stores evaluated on the identical 50-query furniture pack; per-query result counts and top-8 titles preserved (iw-captures.json, sb-captures.json).
Each returned product graded 0-3 by Cortex (llama3.2:3b) with per-(query,product) reason preserved (iw-ndcg-results.json, sb-ndcg-results.json).
Coverage (zero-result rate) and precision (mean grade, %relevant>=2, %junk<=1) computed per store; NDCG reported alongside grade-quality because uniform-low-grade lists inflate NDCG.
Findings IW-SR-001..004, SB-SR-001..003, BOTH-SR-001, MIG-SR-001 recorded in findings.json, each with embedded evidence pointer + severity.

Relevance judge validated against a 36-pair hand-labeled furniture gold set: 94% binary relevant/not agreement, 100% within-1, +0.03 bias, conservative on junk (gold-labels.json; recorded in validator-effectiveness.json).

Verified in-browser: board renders, sofa expands to 6 grade-1 results, Re-run NDCG returned matches-stored live.
